This CAPTURE shows a clean run (tool_names all CallDynamicTool, no native Shell), but the leak is intermittent (~1 in 4-5 runs) and reproduces on the pre-existing sibling test too, so it is not fixed by this review — it is an explicitly accepted risk, decided 2026-07-25, not worth engineering around given no code-execution-capable server is exposed in the sessions this project runs today.

The final answer renders the table with cursor's own compact box characters (Field │ Value / build_id │ ...) rather than literal markdown pipes — Cursor CLI's own terminal pretty-printing, same class of cosmetic as claude's box-drawing rendering. report.md on disk is byte-exact markdown; this is a chat-reply rendering cosmetic only.
